cand.title: Concours Hippique International de Genève – 100 years
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and a credible hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is reduced by venue commitment or unresolved sourcing.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Sophie Mottu Morel is the current Director General and a relevant senior relationship sponsor; the Marriott partnership article names her in the relationship. Frédérique de Lint is currently listed for General Secretariat & VIP and is a relevant routing/guest-programme contact. Nadja Burkhardt is explicitly identified in the 2025 bureau profile as handling rider transport and hôtellerie, making her the most functionally relevant accommodation candidate, subject to reconfirming her 2026 remit. None is proven to hold sole hotel-contract authority. Route through accommodation@chi-geneve.ch or the official bureau, +41 22 738 18 00; no personal email is established.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: centenary CHI Geneva, 9–13 December 2026, five days of international competition at Palexpo. These are activity dates, not publication dates. As of the research cutoff, no exact official CHI Geneva dates were located for 2027 or January–June 2028. A volunteer notice explicitly anticipates the 66th edition in 2027 but does not give activity dates. Do not substitute dates for other Rolex Grand Slam competitions.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: conditional fit for a small, transport-supported accommodation subset, not hosting the competition. A 20–120-room proposal would be a hotel commercial target band only, never a published CHIG requirement. YOTEL’s 237 rooms and approximately 250-theatre meeting capacity cannot replace Palexpo’s equestrian infrastructure. Founex is outside the event municipality; airport-corridor access alone does not prove acceptable transfer arrangements. Possible audiences to test are exhibitors, sponsors or independently booked visitors, not already allocated riders/organizers. Meeting/F&B add-ons are hypothetical and should be demand-led; no resort requirement is evidenced.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland, is explicitly confirmed for 2026. Territory classification: Geneva Airport corridor; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not central Geneva city, and not Lausanne. This is an exhibition/event venue, not a competing hotel. The centenary competition is not a venue-sourcing lead.
findings.historicalRotation: Recent editions are consistently at Palexpo: 6–10 December 2023, 11–15 December 2024 and 10–14 December 2025. Official history records the first Palexpo edition in 1991. Evidence supports a recurring Geneva/Palexpo event, not a rotating destination association congress. The centenary is 100 years since foundation in 1926, not 100 consecutive annual editions.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific official accommodation page names Geneva Marriott Hotel, Chemin du Ruisseau 1, 1216 Meyrin, as “Geneva Marriott, l’hôtel du CHI de Genève.” It instructs: “Pour toute question concernant le logement à Genève pendant le CHIG, merci de nous écrire un mail à l’adresse suivante: accommodation@chi-geneve.ch”. This establishes an organizer-controlled enquiry route, not an external housing bureau. Every hotel identified in the reviewed 2026 lodging material: Geneva Marriott Hotel only. The 2026 brochure additionally states “ACCUEIL DE L’ÉLITE ÉQUESTRE AU GENEVA MARRIOTT HOTEL”. Stronger historical operational evidence: the 2024 article says the Marriott hosts “le comité d’organisation ainsi que les cavaliers et leur entourage pendant toute la durée du concours.” No published block size, rates, available inventory, open RFP or external housing agency was located. Do not interpret the hotel’s 263 guestrooms/suites as CHIG room demand.
findings.organizationStructure: Association du CHI de Genève (ACHIG), with President Thierry Naz and Vice-President Guillaume Mottu, is distinguished on the official site from the organizing committee led by Director General Sophie Mottu Morel. This is an association-organized international equestrian sports event with a centenary programme, not principally a corporate/private celebration or association congress. Palexpo is the venue; Geneva Marriott is the incumbent hotel partner. No separately appointed PCO/DMC or external housing bureau was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Geneva Marriott is an edition-specific incumbent, corroborated by 2026 collateral and actual historical lodging of organizers/riders/entourages. Its public role does not disclose exclusivity, block sizes or contract expiry. No documented overflow, hotel sell-out or additional accommodation requirement was found. Official sustainability reporting says most spectators, volunteers and service providers are regional; the volunteer page explicitly says volunteers are not housed by CHIG. The historical 49,200-plus attendance must not be converted to bedrooms or room nights.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the official accommodation desk now, addressing Nadja Burkhardt subject to remit confirmation and copying/routing via Frédérique de Lint. Reference the existing Marriott partnership; ask whether any 2026 exhibitors/sponsors/independent groups remain unallocated and whether Founex with agreed transport is acceptable. Ask for actual arrival/departure patterns, peak rooms, budget, payment owner and booking channel before quoting. If no residual requirement exists, seek a post-event discussion with Sophie Mottu Morel about the next edition’s supplementary-hotel process and decision timetable. Do not propose moving the competition or claim an open RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low/conditional, not confirmed open. Palexpo is committed and the elite-rider hotel pathway points to Marriott. An organizer accommodation enquiry is publicly accessible, but no alternative-hotel procurement invitation or residual demand is published. Approach only to test an unallocated segment and its transfer requirements; do not present the centenary as an awarded or qualified YOTEL group.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: a recurring Palexpo sports event can support relationship development for later supplementary lodging. The official volunteer page anticipates a 2027 edition, but exact event dates and hotel procurement windows remain unannounced in the sources reviewed. Compete for an organizer-approved secondary segment only after checking Marriott’s scope and any exclusivity; neither destination rotation nor incumbent displacement is established.
